$comment: Gzipped bytes per dist-cdn manifest entry, including every chunk it imports (static and dynamic), each counted once. About 12% over the sizes at 1.0.0; checked by test/size-budget.test.mjs. Print today's sizes with: node scripts/bundle-sizes.mjs. Dark mode (color-scheme-switch) raised site-page.js, site-header.js and tokens.css to about 12% over their sizes with it. bento-box.js (with its four sections) is about 12% over its first size, 19,741 B. Analytics: site-page.js counts its lazy site-analytics (loaded only with matomo-id) and grew by 2,620 B to 36,829 B, so its budget rose by that plus 12% to 39,800; uvalib-analytics.js (the same code as site-analytics.js) is about 12% over its first size, 10,225 B. Breadcrumbs: uvalib-breadcrumbs.js is about 12% over its first size, 10,576 B; site-page.js grew 171 B for the breadcrumbs slot (37,336 B, within its budget). Alerts UI: site-page.js counts its lazy site-alerts (loaded only while alerts are on) and grew by 8,600 B to 46,379 B, so its budget rose by that plus 12% to 49,400; site-alerts.js (with its analytics reporting) is about 12% over its first size, 17,967 B; tokens.css grew 201 B to 1,384 B for the --uva-color-alert-* role tokens, budget 1,550. Analytics v2 (1.3.0): the components that now report (the hours elements, events-section, the filter, date range and breadcrumbs) import the small track* helper chunk (src/base/analytics.ts, about 600 B gzipped; the shared state and site-page's buffer stay in their own chunk), plus their own delegated listeners. site-analytics.js grew 1,287 B to 12,124 B for Do Not Track / Global Privacy Control, data-uvalib-track, spa="auto" (pushState wrapper, route listeners) and the download types; uvalib-analytics.js is the same code. Budgets over their limit rose by the growth, keeping their old headroom: site-analytics.js 12,200, uvalib-analytics.js 12,800, library-weekly-hours.js (+710 B to 16,991) 17,100, library-hours-setup.js (+712 B to 17,595) 17,800, events-section.js (+776 B to 16,211) 16,500. The others grew within their budgets (site-page.js +1,920 B to 48,873). Site name and host buttons (1.3.0): site-header.js grew 465 B to 24,924 B for site-name (its own header template, so the header without a name stays byte-identical), budget 25,200; site-page.js, which bundles the header, grew 507 B to 49,441 B, budget 49,900; tokens.css grew 114 B to 1,498 B for the five --uva-color-button-* role tokens, budget 1,700; base.css now also holds the .uvalib-button, toggle, .uvalib-input and .uvalib-search-form classes (base.css only, no component bundle carries them) and grew from 372 B to 1,463 B, budget 1,650 (about 12% over). Review fixes: site-header.js +369 B to 25,293 B (the site name moves under the logo when the links would not fit beside it: a measured fit with a ResizeObserver), budget 25,700; site-page.js +370 B to 49,811 B, budget 50,300; base.css +435 B to 1,898 B (the dark-mode role tokens it reads, so it works without tokens.css, and the real component tags it skips), budget 2,150.
